502:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Miss $$マリーダ$$? Is that jerk $$リディ$$ on your mind?」

502:t_10:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You call me, a former enemy, 'Miss,' and call him, who was an ally, a jerk, huh.」

502:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To a merchant, what matters most is whether it benefits him, after all.」

502:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「On that note, today Miss $$マリーダ$$ fought $$リディ$$ and produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. You are a most valued customer.」

502:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, I've added them to the unit's stock, mind you.」

502:t_10:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That mobile suit... When I was riding the $$バンシィ$$, the Master and $$バナージ$$ saved me...」

502:t_10:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So I thought that maybe it's my turn to help him now...」

502:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$マリーダ$$ was forced to ride that thing after being readjusted, but that jerk $$リディ$$ rides it of his own free will...」

502:t_10:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No, it's no different... Him, me... and that person, too. All of us have had our way of living bound by something.」

502:t_10:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I remember it vaguely. The face of that person, who was always peering at me with such worry...」

502:t_10:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Different from the Master... but I felt the same thing from that person...」

502:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That person... was thinking of you, Miss $$マリーダ$$.」

502:t_10:19.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Maybe that's why... I've only ever been protected, but I want to try.」

502:t_10:20.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...It may be presumptuous of me to think I could save anyone, though.」

502:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood, Miss $$マリーダ$$. In that case, you'll first need to make contact with $$リディ$$ and understand how he feels.」

502:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please be careful. If you get in too deep, it will put your life in danger.」

502:t_10:23.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I'll remember those words.」

502:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do your best, Miss $$マリーダ$$. I'm looking forward to you producing more quality $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

502:t_10:32.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you had any business with me, that's about all it would be.」

502:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not it. There's a photo I'd like you to buy.」

502:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... One I obtained from a certain source, of Mr. $$ヒイロ$$ and Miss $$リリーナ$$...」

502:t_10:38.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I've already had the original data erased. I can't hand my sister's private photos over to a shameless lout.」

502:t_10:43.en:
$$刹那$$
「No need to worry about it. Just leave the rest to $$ゼクス$$.」

502:t_10:44.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But this leaves the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ without a guide.」

502:t_10:47.en:
$$刹那$$
「Well then, let's give it our all again today...」

502:t_10:49.en:
$n
「...Before I knew it, it seems I'm the only one left who refuses that...」

503:t_001:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Miss $$スメラギ$$ has a mean streak, doesn't she.」

503:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I can feel it now, what she meant when she said only a fool could carry out this operation.」

503:t_002:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Already living up to expectations. Then...」

503:t_003:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Nearly half our forces gone in an instant...!」

503:t_003:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Impossible! No matter how overwhelming their firepower is, charging in with a single unit!」

503:t_003:2.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「At this rate we can't hold our formation!」

503:t_003:3.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Intercept them! We can't let a mere vanguard do whatever it wants any longer!」

503:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No wonder they're confused. Charging into a situation you know is a trap must seem insane.」

503:t_003:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But a fool can do it. And that is what opens a breakthrough in the situation.」

503:t_003:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have no intention of dying until I've rescued $$リリーナ$$.」

503:t_003:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「After all, it's only the life of a foolish man! There is nothing I would begrudge spending on my sister!」

503:t_004:1.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「I don't like it. I want to go out there and pluck those white wings off.」

503:t_004:2.en:
$$グエン$$
「Gundams aren't only white, you know.」

503:t_004:4.en:
$$グエン$$
「Now then... How will $$クィーン$$'s fate turn out...」

503:t_005:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Good timing. The main force has arrived, too.」

503:t_006:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「In other words, you don't plan to die until you've rescued the young lady, huh.」

503:t_006:3.en:
$n
「It seems $$クロノ$$ isn't using Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ as a hostage.」

503:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Does that mean the information that the Vice Minister was captured was a hoax to begin with?」

503:t_006:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Judging from everything so far, I can't imagine $$クィーン$$ would spread false information.」

503:t_006:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Let's leave that for later...! The main force is coming out!」

503:t_007:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I see! With this much firepower, they don't need to use a hostage!」
